product: SRTMDEM 90M 分辨率原始高程数据

tileGrid.interpretation: The two numeric fields are 5-degree Geospatial Data Cloud grid indices, not longitude/latitude degrees. Example verified from portal: srtm_51_02 has centre 72.5E, 52.5N.
tileGrid.targetInterpretation: Rows 52-59 span approximately 55N to 15N; columns 2-15 span approximately 70E to 140E. This is the conservative 5-degree grid envelope for China, Hainan and Taiwan.

coverageAssessment.usableFor: A deliberately labelled western/partial terrain pipeline test only.
coverageAssessment.notUsableFor: A complete official-map terrain layer: the data ends effectively at 110E and contains internal holes. It lacks much of eastern China, coastal China, Hainan and Taiwan.

archiveIntegrity.note: Structural ZIP validation only; CRS and raster-value validation wait until the input grid is complete and a GeoTIFF/GDAL-capable environment is available.
